Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:227-260` adds the `Waterjet Profile workflow (#1883)` section immediately before `## Plasma Profile workflow (#1871)`.
- The example commands match `WaterjetDto`, `WaterjetOp::is_sane`, `ToolDto`, `camcraft_tools::waterjet::refusal`, and `crates/app/tests/mcp_waterjet.rs` in PR #3058 (`aded58c477b18dd9c21b502be39dbf057dec0c4c`).
- The guide states clearly that `#1883` (PR #3058) is not yet on `main`, that no built-in waterjet exists, that `pierce_time` and `abrasive_delay` appear in path notes only until `#1882`, and that no post serves a waterjet yet.
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests/test_waterjet_workflow.py` includes a provenance header, validates JSON syntax in the guide, and pins the machine, nozzle, parameter keys, enum values, and limits.
- `docs/decisions/3048-waterjet-workflow.md` records the decision in the standard format without editing `RECOMMENDED.md` or `CHANGELOG.md`.
- The PR body includes `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none`, and `Fixes #3048`, and does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The commit subject follows Conventional Commits.

## Results merged with main

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3272`. No GitHub runner or workflow ran. The branch trial-merged cleanly with `upstream/main` (`dfbe0d8a542f8305752d99985bdb8891eb5d66c4`) with zero conflicts (`Already up to date`).

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 0 Rust steps, 0 failed (no crate changed) |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` | Passed: reaches no heavy lane |
| `python3 -m unittest discover -s .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests -p test_*.py -v` | Passed: 7 passed, 0 failed (3 new tests, 4 existing tests) |
| `cargo clippy` | Not applicable (no Rust crate changed) |

## Extra suites run

- `testdata/` and fixture suites: none apply. The diff changes no files under `testdata/` or golden directories.
- Importer suites: none apply. The diff touches no STEP, mesh, or model import code.
- Skill Python suite: `python3 -m unittest discover -s .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests -p test_*.py -v` (7 passed, 0 failed).

## Safety tier

- Not applicable. The diff changes no posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No golden files changed.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes

- Non-blocking: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests/test_waterjet_workflow.py:13` calls `.read_text()` without `encoding="utf-8"`. This matches the existing tests in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/tests/`, though `SKILL.md` contains UTF-8 box-drawing characters. Passing `encoding="utf-8"` improves Windows portability.
- Non-blocking: update the availability note in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:229-230` after `#1883` merges to `main`, as `docs/decisions/3048-waterjet-workflow.md` notes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
